newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CPFL downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CPFL downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said in a report it was downgrading Sao Paulo state power utility company Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz (CPFL) to hold from buy.
-- It said the company's share price has risen 50 percent so far this year against an increase of 36 percent of the Sao Paulo bourse index Ibovespa in the same period.
-- It said the company is fully priced versus its sector peers.
-- CPFL's preferred shares were trading at 125 reais up 0.64 percent.
